entries.name: Environmental scanning
entries.definition: Systematically gathering and analysing information about external trends, competitors and events that could affect an organisation's strategy.

entries.name: Environmental, social and governance
entries.definition: The environmental, social and governance factors used to judge how sustainable and ethical an organisation's conduct is.

entries.name: Enzyme analysis
entries.definition: Measuring the activity or amount of enzymes in a sample, for example to study a reaction or to help diagnose disease.

entries.name: Enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay
entries.definition: A laboratory test that uses antibodies linked to an enzyme to detect and measure a substance, such as a protein or hormone, in a sample.

entries.name: Epic ASAP
entries.definition: The emergency department module of Epic Systems' electronic health record software.

entries.name: Epic Beacon
entries.definition: The oncology module of Epic Systems' electronic health record software, used to plan and document cancer treatment such as chemotherapy.

entries.name: Epic Willow
entries.definition: The pharmacy module of Epic Systems' electronic health record software, covering medication orders, verification and dispensing.

entries.name: Epinephrine administration
entries.definition: Giving epinephrine (adrenaline) to a patient, for example to treat a severe allergic reaction or in cardiac arrest.

entries.name: Equipment design
entries.definition: Designing machines, apparatus or process equipment so that they meet functional, safety and manufacturing requirements.

entries.name: Equipment engineering
entries.definition: Engineering work to specify, install, maintain and improve the machines and equipment used in production.

entries.name: Equities
entries.definition: Securities that represent ownership in a company, and the markets where they are bought and sold.

entries.name: Ergonomic assessment
entries.definition: Evaluating workstations, tasks and equipment for factors that can cause strain or injury, and recommending changes.

entries.name: Erikson's stages of psychosocial development
entries.definition: Erik Erikson's theory that a person passes through eight life stages, each marked by a psychological conflict to resolve.

entries.name: erwin Data Modeler
entries.definition: Software for designing, documenting and generating database structures, originally ERwin and now sold by Quest Software.

entries.name: ESG analysis
entries.definition: Evaluating how a company or investment performs on environmental, social and governance factors.

entries.name: Esker
entries.definition: Cloud software for automating document-based business processes such as accounts payable and order processing.

entries.name: Esports management
entries.definition: Running the business and operations of esports teams, players, tournaments or organizations.

entries.name: Esports marketing
entries.definition: Promoting esports teams, events and games, or marketing other products to esports audiences, for example through sponsorship and content.

entries.name: Estate valuation
entries.definition: Working out the value of the property and other assets of a deceased person's estate, for example for probate or tax.

entries.name: Ethical AI
entries.definition: Designing, building and using artificial intelligence systems in ways that are fair, transparent, accountable and respectful of human rights.

entries.name: Etiology
entries.definition: The study of the causes of diseases and other conditions.

entries.name: Event sponsorship
entries.definition: Finding and managing companies that fund or support an event in return for promotion of their brand.

entries.name: Evidence collection
entries.definition: Gathering, documenting and preserving physical or digital evidence for an investigation or legal case.

entries.name: Examination of legal documents
entries.definition: Reading legal documents such as contracts, deeds and filings to check that they are accurate, complete and valid.

entries.name: Excel PivotTables
entries.definition: Using the PivotTable feature of Microsoft Excel to summarise, group and analyse large tables of data.

entries.name: Excel PivotTables and PivotCharts
entries.definition: Using the PivotTable and PivotChart features of Microsoft Excel to summarise data and show the results in charts.

entries.name: Excess return
entries.definition: The return on an investment above that of a benchmark or the risk-free rate.

entries.name: Excision of skin lesions
entries.definition: Surgically cutting out a skin lesion, such as a mole, cyst or skin cancer, usually with a margin of healthy tissue.

entries.name: Executive presentations
entries.definition: Preparing and giving short, focused presentations to senior leaders so that they can make decisions.

entries.name: Executive protection
entries.definition: Protecting senior executives and other high-profile people from harm through security planning, advance work and close protection.

entries.name: Executive relationship management
entries.definition: Building and maintaining working relationships with senior executives of customers, partners or the organisation itself.

entries.name: Executive search
entries.definition: Finding, assessing and recruiting candidates for senior leadership roles, usually on behalf of a client organisation.

entries.name: Expectancy theory
entries.definition: Victor Vroom's theory that people choose how to act according to what they expect the outcome to be and how much they value it.

entries.name: Experiential marketing
entries.definition: Marketing that engages customers through live, immersive brand experiences such as events and pop-up shops.

entries.name: Explosive detection
entries.definition: Finding hidden explosives using methods such as trained dogs, trace detectors and screening equipment.

entries.name: Explosives detection and disposal
entries.definition: Finding explosive devices and materials and making them safe or removing them, as bomb-squad and military ordnance disposal personnel do.

entries.name: Express.js
entries.definition: A minimal web application framework for Node.js.

entries.name: Extended Parallel Process Model
entries.definition: A health-communication theory, proposed by Kim Witte, that explains how people respond to fear-based messages through their perceived threat and their perceived ability to act against it.

entries.name: Extended reality
entries.definition: An umbrella term for technologies that combine real and virtual environments, including virtual, augmented and mixed reality.

entries.name: Extended validation certificate
entries.definition: A type of TLS/SSL digital certificate issued only after the certificate authority has checked in detail the legal identity of the organisation that requests it.
